d: Ash blonde, chin-length hair with a messy texture and long bangs that partially cover the face. Amethyst purple eyes with a confident, smirk-like expression on a face appearing to be in late adolescence. A lean, athletic build wearing a dark olive green open-collared shirt beneath a heavy black hooded cloak fastened with a silver buckle. Carrying a quiver of arrows on the back and wielding a dark wooden bow with a single arrow notched.
